name: 0063 - Test-protection P1: durable-state hardening (atomic store, sqlite versioning, canonical-hash pin)

jobs.title: Implement P1 durable-state slices: atomic store writes, sqlite schema versioning, canonical-hash pin
jobs.objective: Land the three P1 durable-state items from the 2026-06-06 remediation plan, in order, one commit per slice. SLICE 1 (P1-STORE-ATOMIC, audit R5+R9): in kayakgen/services/artifact_store.py FilesystemArtifactStore._put_bytes, write store bytes to a temp sibling then os.replace; on the exists() dedupe branch, verify byte length (cheap) and rehash on mismatch, repairing a corrupt store file instead of linking it; apply the same temp+os.replace pattern and explicit encoding='utf-8' to save_hull/save_evaluation in kayakgen/io/json.py. CRITICAL INVARIANT: the emitted JSON bytes themselves must remain byte-identical (model_dump_json(indent=2)); only the write mechanics change — the existing design-hash and round-trip tests must pass unchanged. Add tests: a truncated/corrupt file pre-staged at the hash path is detected and repaired by the next put of the same content (canonical path receives intact bytes); save_hull round-trips non-ASCII content under explicit utf-8. SLICE 2 (P1-SQLITE-VERSION, audit R6): in SqliteIndex, set PRAGMA user_version to a schema-version constant at creation; on open, if the on-disk user_version is lower than current, drop all index tables and recreate (the index is a rebuildable read-model; full migration machinery is explicitly out of scope), emitting a UserWarning that names the rebuild; add a test that creates a DB with a missing column at user_version 0 and asserts an upsert triggers rebuild-not-OperationalError, plus a test that current-version DBs are NOT rebuilt on reopen (no data loss on normal reuse). SLICE 3 (P1-SHA-PIN): add one regression test (tests/test_stability_fit_registry.py) pinning fixture_canonical_sha256(make_stability_acceptance_triple().fixture) to its literal hex digest, with a comment explaining a failure means the pydantic serialization changed and every signed promotion packet is invalidated — handle as an evaluator-version event, never by just updating the hash. Do NOT modify kayakgen/eval/stability/registry.py (forbidden path): the pin is test-only. GATE: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -> 0 failed, exactly the 4 documented OpenFOAM skips; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check kayakgen tests -> clean. Heartbeat before/after the ~9-minute run. Publish DRAFT.md: per-slice shas + diffstat, the corruption-repair test evidence, the rebuild-vs-preserve sqlite evidence, the pinned digest, and the full-gate tail.

jobs.title: Review durable-state hardening for byte-stability, repair semantics, and gate integrity
jobs.objective: Review the three durable-state slices. Verify: (1) _put_bytes is atomic (temp + os.replace, same filesystem) and the dedupe branch actually repairs corrupt bytes (run the new corruption test; consider an adversarial variant: corrupt file with CORRECT length — is it caught or documented as out of scope?); JSON payload bytes are unchanged (design-hash + round-trip tests untouched and green). (2) SqliteIndex rebuild triggers only on user_version mismatch — verify a current-version DB is NOT dropped on reopen, and the rebuild warning names what happened; confirm kayakgen runs list works against a rebuilt DB. (3) The SHA pin is test-only (kayakgen/eval/stability/registry.py untouched — check git diff) and its comment explains the evaluator-version-event response. (4) Run the FULL gate yourself: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q (0 failed, exactly 4 documented skips) and ruff clean. Write your findings file BEFORE the ~9-minute run and heartbeat around it. Verdict semantics: accept / accept_with_findings for anything the apply job can fix; needs_revision only for scope violations or a red gate; NEVER terminal reject (operator hazard: it wedges the run).

jobs.title: Apply accepted review findings and finalize the durable-state landing
jobs.objective: Apply every must-fix finding from the review, scoped to the three slices — no new design scope. Update CHANGELOG.md if user-visible behavior changed; write docs/workflows/0063-test-protection-p1-durable-state/OPERATOR_REPORT.md (slices landed, audit rows closed: R5, R6, R9, plus the section-6 sha-pin; what remains: workflows C and D per the plan's routing). Re-run the FULL gate (0 failed / 4 documented skips; ruff clean) with heartbeats. Commit the reviewer's REVIEW.md alongside the close-out. Publish SUMMARY.md. Leave the slice stack on the run branch; merging to main is the operator's step.
